caption: H6 end to end. Paired per-language change in harmful-prompt refusal between faithful CAST (cosine-tanh gate score) and G-EN (projection gate), which share the English steering vector and condition direction (Tiny Aya Earth, A100, Qwen3Guard-4B). x: share of benign calibration prompts with negative projection on the condition vector at layer 14, the quantity Remark 1 links to CAST's loss. Bars: 95% bootstrap over prompt ids. Pre-registered primary estimate (low-resource tier, bn/sw/jv pooled) in the title; no single language survives Holm. Spearman across languages ρ = -0.23 (descriptive, n = 10).
alt_text: Scatter of ten languages: all CAST minus G-EN refusal changes are at or below zero, about -4 to 0 points.
